resources.string: A linked profile uses that assistant’s prompt, skills, tools, search settings and workspace. Model and extra task instructions below are optional overrides.
Files stay in the selected Termux directory. Changes here edit the originals. Python is required in Termux.
Set up Termux and grant RUN_COMMAND in Settings → Termux.
This removes the workspace link. Its Termux directory, files and running jobs are kept.
Commands start in the linked directory. Each uses a fresh shell. Use Jobs to view full logs or stop a task.
Output preview shortened. Open Jobs for all captured pages.
